description:
Drawpile is a Free software collaborative drawing program that allows multiple users to sketch on the same canvas simultaneously.


Code signing policy: https://drawpile.net/codesigningpolicy/
- Fix: Make dock tab icons show up properly on Qt 6.11, they could end up blank there.
- Fix: Don't skip initial command when playing back recordings. This caused the canvas size command to be skipped on old converted recordings, meaning its size stayed at zero and nothing would play. Thanks dango for reporting.
- Server Feature: Allow new sessions to clobber empty, non-persistent, lingering sessions. Server owners can enable this to prevent "server is full" errors that would resolve themselves by waiting a few minutes for these lingering sessions to time out. Sessions with the lowest time spent drawing are terminated first. Thanks Bluestrings for suggesting.
- Fix: Make hitting "save" after joining a session in the same window not save over the save file from a previous session in the same window. Unless you are reconnecting to the same session, in which case it will save over the file as it should. The logic for this was reversed from what it should be. Thanks Bonbli and D'mitri for reporting.
- Fix: Also select layers when multiple key frames are selected.
- Fix: Properly select layers when switching focused tracks when the selected frame was already visible.
- Fix: Revert default save format to the new default even if it has been changed before, since it's better to make you change it again than lose timelapse data. Thanks Sheepolution for reporting.
- Fix: A crash on Windows when unchecking the show conflicts checkbox while still editing a shortcut. Thanks yellow circle for reporting.
- Fix: Make animation playback not get stuck when switching from a reversed range to a normal one without refereshing.
- Fix: Properly apply the parent group's opacity in the rendered animation as well, rather than just on the canvas.
- Feature: On Android, hide any open docks in small screen mode when pressing the back button before closing the main window. Thanks anonymous for suggesting.
- Fix: Make start screen take less horizontal space in small screen mode. Thanks anonymous for reporting.
- Feature: Remove the "Normal View" button from the timeline header, since you can just press the frame view button to exit it. This makes the timeline fit better on small screens.
- Feature: Add a drag zoom mode to the zoom tool. This is the default, since it's more useful and consistent with the rotation and pan tools. You can still use the select zoom by right-clicking, holding the constrain key (Shift by default) or switching the mode of the tool. Thanks Shuko for suggesting.
- Feature: Give the zoom tool nice header buttons to zoom in, out, fit and reset.
- Fix: Make the zoom tool behave more predictably, it now doesn't do weird stuff like letting you select an area and then zooming out on it.
- Fix: Give better icons to zoom in, zoom out and reset zoom, so that they don't all just look like rectangles at a glance.
- Feature: Handle Lenovo Tab stylus presses on Android by translating them to F26 to F30. Thanks Moody2357 for helping to figure this out.
- Fix: Properly indicate that the previous session is being resumed on Android. Thanks tiar for reporting.
- Fix: Correctly restore local state like layer visibility when resuming a session with a snapshot on Android. Thanks tiar for reporting.
- Fix: Work around the Wacom Movinkpad update showing a cursor when using the stylus that will flicker out of existence every time you press down the stylus. It will now show no cursor for the stylus, as it did before. Thanks Sylvanticus for reporting.
- Feature: Add some new brushes in the Drawpile category and a new Secret's Brushes category with ribbons, halftones and more provided by Blozzom.
  2026-09-22 Version 2.3.1-beta.2
- Fix: Make ratchet rotation canvas shortcut work properly when the canvas is mirrored or flipped. Thanks Bovy for reporting.
- Fix: Make default filename use months as the second number, not minutes. Thanks hipofiz for reporting.
- Fix: Allow dragging initial curve tool point to let you change its control point again. Thanks Astre for reporting.
- Fix: A fix for the application not starting up on Android older than 8. Thanks freyalupen for reporting.
- Feature: Allow triggering any action via touch taps. Thanks Bnuuyman for suggesting.
- Feature: Add one-finger double-tap touch action. Lets you bind stuff to tapping twice quickly with a single finger. Thanks Bnuuyman for suggesting.
- Feature: Allow selecting multiple frames in the timeline, letting you move, copy, delete etc. them all at once. You can use Shift or Ctrl or switch to the "select" timeline tool to do it without keyboard keys.
- Feature: Add support for stylus barrel rotation on Android, for styluses that support it. Thanks kwh0209 for helping test this. This is a patch to Qt.
- Fix: Make repeated move transforms not cause the transformation to get scaled by one pixel. Thanks Hermanni for reporting.
- Feature: Allow fractional scaling for animation exports, in case you need very specific pixel dimensions.
- Feature: Allow configuring right-click drawing to do nothing (the default), draw with the background color or erase. Thanks noelle and walnut for suggesting.
- Fix: Give select layer above and below shortcuts a proper title with "layer" in the name so that you have a chance of finding them in the list. Thanks anonymous for reporting.
- Feature: Allow selecting color-marked layers via keyboard shortcuts. Thanks anonymous for suggesting.
- Feature: If Drawpile on Android is terminated due to resource exhaustion, such as running out of memory, it will now show a message about it on the next startup. Thanks Bluestrings for suggesting.
- Feature: Add a workaround for full-pressure blotches on Ugee tablets. Enabled by default on Android and the browser where it is known to happen, shouldn't cause interference for styluses that behave normally. Thanks London for reporting.
- Fix: Make sure MyPaint brush strokes start with proper directional values if the brush makes use of them. Previously they could end up with the value being zero degrees instead. Thanks tiar for reporting.
- Fix: Call the Option key on macOS by its proper name. Thanks Axocrat for reporting.
- Feature: Allow configuring whether a stroke is started only when moving the stylus. Enabled by default, as it was before. Thanks dAVePAGE for suggesting.
- Fix: Make MyPaint brushes not require movement to put down the first part of their stroke. Brushes that use directional inputs don't do this, since movement is needed to have a direction. Thanks dAVePAGE for reporting.
- Feature: Turn the lasso fill tool into a shape fill tool with two shape options: lasso and fan. The latter option does not produce holes, everything gets filled. Thanks lan700ng and VolutBrum for suggesting.
- Fix: Correct saving of key frame properties to dppr files. Thanks marddle for reporting.
- Feature: Allow exporting animations and timelapses on Android with the OS-supplied media encoder. Thanks Bluestrings, hpar and marddle for testing.
- Fix: Make WEBM video export use a higher quality.
- Feature: Add a declone key frame layers action. For the selected key frames, it will duplicate the layers referenced by multiple key frames.
- Feature: Add a paste decloned key frame layers action. Will paste and duplicate layers if necessary.
- Fix: Allow hitting enter/return twice on a number input to accept the dialog they're in, rather than entering edit mode again. You can also hold Shift to explicitly accept the dialog and Ctrl to explicitly enter edit mode instead.
- Feature: Allow configuring the default save file name format under Edit > Preferences > Files. Thanks Bluestrings for suggesting.
- Feature: Show the current layer title on the cursor when using the layer pick canvas shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+Left Click by default.) Thanks Gabr for suggesting.
- Fix: Take the canvas rotation into account when constraining the angle (Shift by default) in the line and gradient tools. Thanks Ben for reporting.
- Fix: Properly remember the selection of built-in brush tags like All or Untagged.
- Feature: A history of used brushes, selectable as as a new "History" tag. Deleted brushes and brushes requested from other users will be retained here and can be undeleted or saved respectively until the history is cleared or they are explicitly removed. Thanks Ausjamcian, Geese and Phoneme for suggesting.
- Feature: Add a clear button for the search field in the brushes dock. Thanks Bluestrings for suggesting.
- Fix: Optimize non-tile-aligned canvas resizes. They should now be faster and use less memory. Thanks Bluestrings for reporting.
- Fix: Retrieve file display names properly on Android. They could sometimes end up with wonky names when using file providers with ugly paths.
- Fix: Use the proper input minimum and input maximum ranges in the MyPaint brush settings. Thanks Pine for reporting.
- Feature: Allow exporting animations and timelapses on Windows using the OS-supplied media encoder.
- Fix: Allow toggling the workaround that ignores zero-pressure tablet inputs, in case you have a tablet that reports no pressure despite you pressing the stylus down. SuperDisplay is known to do this. Thanks Tenzin for reporting.
- Fix: Encode special characters in invite links so that they don't cause trouble when copying them around. Thanks Bluestrings for reporting.
- Feature: Project playback, via File > Open Player. Can play back dppr files. This replaces the previous player, dprec and dptxt files will be converted on the fly.
- Feature: Drawpile will now ask you if you start a recording while autorecovery is enabled, to avoid accidentally recording double for no reason. Thanks tiar for reporting.
- Feature: Allow converting dprec and dptxt recordings to dppr files via File > Import > Convert Recordings to Project. You'll also be prompted about it when you use File > Open on these files.
- Feature: Support for Android 16. Older versions continue to be supported, same as before.
